scripts.dev: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && npm run dev -w @sheetdelta/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && npm run build -w @sheetdelta/web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.pack:core: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts', {recursive:true})" && npm pack -w sheetdelta-core --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.site:build: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && WEB_BASE=/playground/ npm run build -w @sheetdelta/web && npm run docs:build && node scripts/assemble-site.mjs
scripts.bench:core: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark.mjs
scripts.check:worker: node scripts/check-worker-example.mjs && tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,WebWorker examples/browser/compare.worker.ts && tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM examples/browser/client.ts
scripts.bench:stream: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && node --max-old-space-size=128 scripts/benchmark-stream.mjs
scripts.docs:api: npm run build -w sheetdelta-core && node scripts/check-api-docs.mjs --write
